source_quote: is a program carefully designed to prepare graduates for successful careers in marketing
answer: The BBA in Marketing and Advertising prepares graduates for careers in marketing communications in the media services and advertising industry, building on a business and marketing core with marketing, advertising, public relations and marketing communications. It requires 99 credits.

source_quote: BMKA 485 Strategic Marketing 3 Senior Standing
answer: Marketing and Advertising mandatory courses: BADM 485 Co-op, BADM 490 Entrepreneurship, BMKA 310 Consumer Behavior, BMKA 365 Sales Management, BMKA 370 Marketing Research, BMKA 380 Advertising Media and Strategies, BMKA 430 Advertising Design and Creativity, BMKA 440 Social Media Marketing, BMKA 485 Strategic Marketing, and a 3-credit Major Elective.

source_quote: the student must study 3 credit hours of major electives. Major electives could be upper-
answer: Marketing and Advertising students take 3 credits of major electives, e.g., BADM 480 Independent Studies, BMGT 300 Project Management, BMKA 320 Introduction to Public Relations, BMKA 405 Media Planning Analysis and Management, or BMKA 450 Events Marketing and Management.

source_quote: the essential prerequisites for co-op training, the program may stipulate additional
answer: Marketing and Advertising students complete 8 weeks of Co-op training (BADM 485), usually in the summer of the third year, with faculty follow-up, reports, posters and presentations; ENGL 217 and Senior Standing are the essential prerequisites.

source_quote: executive, communications and media planner, advertising and promotion manager,
answer: Marketing and Advertising careers include account executive, communications and media planner, advertising and promotion manager, sales manager, brand manager and marketing manager.

source_quote: Develop integrated marketing communication strategies through
answer: Marketing and Advertising outcomes: apply business knowledge in decision-making; develop integrated marketing communication strategies through ad designs, promotions and media plans; communicate effectively; analyze business problems; and respond to ethical dilemmas.

source_quote: credit hours spread over 6 semesters and 2 summer sessions. The first summer session
answer: Marketing and Advertising spans 6 semesters and 2 summer sessions (Community Engagement, then Co-op). Year 1 Fall (16 cr): BACC 205, BADM 215, BITM 200, BMGT 200, ENGL 210, MATH 207. Year 1 Spring (16 cr): BACC 255, BADM 225, BADM 235, BADM 250, BMKA 200, ENGL 217.

source_quote: BMKA 310 Consumer Behavior 3 BMKA 200;
answer: Marketing Year 2 Fall (18 credits): BADM 230, BECN 301, BFIN 300, BITM 300, BMKA 310 Consumer Behavior, and a Science Elective.

source_quote: BMKA 380 Advertising Media and Strategies 3 BMKA 200
answer: Marketing Year 2 Spring (18 credits): BECN 302, BITM 350, BMKA 370, BMKA 380, GRDS 220 Introduction to Digital Media, and a Social Science Elective; then BADM 290 Community Engagement in the Year 2 summer.

source_quote: BMKA 440 Social Media Marketing 3 Senior Standing
answer: Marketing Year 3 Fall (15 credits): ARAB 212, BMKA 430, BMKA 440, a 1-credit Community & Sustainability course, a Major Elective, and a Humanities/Fine Arts Elective.

source_quote: BMKA 485 Strategic Marketing 3 Senior Standing
answer: Marketing Year 3 Spring (15 credits): BADM 355, BADM 490, BMKA 365, BMKA 485, a Social Science Elective; Year 3 Summer: BADM 485 Co-op (1 credit).

source_quote: This course introduces students to the world of consumer behavior. Students explore
answer: BMKA 310 Consumer Behavior, 3(3,0): how perception, learning, memory, personality, attitudes, life cycle and cultural factors influence consumption, with theory and case studies. Prerequisites: BMKA 200; Junior Standing.

source_quote: This course introduces students to marketing research and its role in the marketing
answer: BMKA 370 Marketing Research, 3(3,0): the marketing research process applied to real problems, ending with a research project using IBM SPSS Statistics and presenting recommendations. Prerequisites: BMKA 200; BADM 250.

source_quote: This course introduces students to the role of advertising in the business world from
answer: BMKA 380 Advertising Media and Strategies, 3(3,0): the advertising industry, communication process, message and creative strategy, campaign design, and strategic media planning and buying from an IMC perspective. Prerequisite: BMKA 200.

source_quote: In this course, students explore and apply principles of graphic design to solve
answer: BMKA 430 Advertising Design and Creativity, 3(3,0): applying graphic design to marketing problems - developing ad concepts into print ads, brochures and online communications, with persuasion, color psychology, composition, copywriting and typography.

answer: BMKA 440 Social Media Marketing, 3(3,0): building social media communication strategies, managing channels, and measuring and reporting results. Prerequisite: Senior Standing.

source_quote: This course explores in depth the concepts and methods of the strategic marketing
answer: BMKA 485 Strategic Marketing, 3(3,0): the strategic marketing planning process using case studies - situational analysis, strategies and tactics for competitive advantage, concluding with a marketing plan. Prerequisite: Senior Standing.

source_quote: This course introduces students to the strategies and tactics of modern public
answer: BMKA 320 Introduction to Public Relations, 3(3,0): modern PR strategies and tactics, PR theory through case campaigns, and planning and evaluating PR campaigns. Prerequisite: BMKA 200.
